title: •Tanus Spijek
caption: •Tanus Spijek (V)
game_text: Once per game, when deployed to a site, opponent loses 1 Force for each Dark Side character present. Draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise.
lore: Male Elom. Former *spy* for the Rebellion. Hired by the Alliance to carry messages between Alderaan and the Rebel base on Yavin 4.

notes: Unique. Stats POWER 2 / ABILITY 1, third box blank; deploy 3 / forfeit 4. Icon column empty. Slip text matches the stub. Alien. Lore matches the scan; 'spy' reads plain weight on the 350 px scan — left unbolded (low-res judgment call, as Tamtel Skreej). Base scan only at 350 px; copyright 1998 (Jabba's Palace). Modern: Virtual Block 3 only (VB3 -pre, 350 px). Bold *spy* inferred from the Jabba's Palace printing pattern (Wooof, Jabba, Fozec show bold characteristics on 745 px scans); only 350 px scans of this card exist.
